caption: The video captures a sunny canal scene centered on a small broadleaf tree with green fruit on its upper right branches. To its left stands a dense bright-green bush, and to its right a darker, sparser tree. Throughout, the leaves and thin upper branches of the central tree flutter and sway gently. The topmost cluster shifts slightly, while the right-side tree's slender branches tremble and the left bush shows minor leaf-level motion. A calm greenish canal runs across the middle, mirroring the sky, the far bank wall, and buildings. Background structures—a tall apartment block, tan and pinkish buildings, low houses, and a utility pole—appear against a clear blue sky and remain broadly stable. The visible movement is mainly foliage sway, with little obvious camera motion.
relations: The central tree's upper leaves and thin branches flutter and sway gently throughout the scene.
The right-side tree's slender branches tremble, while the left bush shows minor leaf-level motion.
The calm greenish canal mirrors the sky, far bank wall, and buildings with stable reflections.
Background structures, including the apartment block and utility pole, remain broadly stable against the clear sky.
